title: OpenWarrant Format 1.0: ticket-profile document frontmatter
description: Hand-written and normative for docs/format/FORMAT-1.0.md sections 2, 3.3 and 4.1. Where this schema and the prose disagree, the prose wins and this schema is the defect. A ticket is a work document with the `ticket` profile (`docs/tickets/<alias>.md` or `docs/tickets/<alias>/ticket.md`): its frontmatter is a document frontmatter (frontmatter.json) whose `profile` is `ticket`, with an `alias`, a `uuid` and a `summary`. The ticket profile's required `Checklist` section and its items (item.json) are in the document body, which this schema does not see.
